01 / The Vision

Exceptional minds.
Extraordinary possibilities.

Learn together. Build something real. Grow your future.

APEX Society is a proposed student-led organization at Texas A&M University focused on artificial intelligence, private equity, economics, and quantitative finance. Students from all majors and experience levels are welcome to express interest.

Our mission is to help students gain practical experience they can talk about in interviews and showcase on their résumés. Through hands-on projects, beginner-friendly workshops, research, and leadership opportunities, members can learn new skills and build meaningful work together.

Learn   ·   Build   ·   Lead

●   At the beginning of something bigger.
We are in our founding stage and are not currently an officially recognized Texas A&M student organization.

01 / Executive Board

Founding Leadership

Co-Founder & President

Gavin Collins

Co-founder and President of APEX Society. Founding executive of APEX Society.

in LinkedIn ↗
Role responsibilities
  • Set the organization’s mission, semester priorities, and measurable goals.
  • Lead weekly executive meetings and track action items.
  • Coordinate university recognition and advisor relationships.
  • Build partnerships with faculty, student groups, and guest speakers.
  • Review division projects and publish a semester impact report.
Co-Founder & Vice President

Kyle Steckler

Co-founder and Vice President of APEX Society. Founding executive of APEX Society.

in LinkedIn ↗
Role responsibilities
  • Manage day-to-day operations and the club calendar.
  • Coordinate director recruitment, onboarding, and accountability.
  • Organize member meetings, workshops, and project showcases.
  • Maintain membership interest records and communicate updates.
  • Step in for the President when needed and monitor deadlines.
Founding Treasurer

Luke Burek

Treasurer of APEX Society.

in LinkedIn ↗
Role responsibilities
  • Draft and maintain a simple semester budget.
  • Track approved spending and retain receipts and records.
  • Research appropriate sponsorships and funding opportunities.
  • Provide a brief financial update at leadership meetings.
  • Follow university financial procedures when applicable; keep membership free during the founding stage.
02 / Directors

Division Leadership

These roles are planned; appointments have not yet been announced.

Director of Artificial Intelligence

To be announced

Director position planned. Name, portrait, and biography forthcoming.

Role responsibilities
  • Lead an accessible AI project using public or appropriately authorized data.
  • Teach introductory AI tools, prompting, and responsible use.
  • Organize project teams and set achievable milestones.
  • Document tools, methods, limitations, and finished demonstrations.
  • Present project outcomes at the semester showcase.
Director of Quantitative Finance

To be announced

Director position planned. Name, portrait, and biography forthcoming.

Role responsibilities
  • Lead a market-data analysis or quantitative research project.
  • Teach beginner-friendly Excel, Python, and statistics workshops.
  • Use public data to explore risk, trends, and model assumptions.
  • Review research quality and explain findings clearly.
  • Publish a documented educational report or dashboard.
Director of Private Equity

To be announced

Director position planned. Name, portrait, and biography forthcoming.

Role responsibilities
  • Lead an educational company research and valuation case study.
  • Teach financial statements, valuation basics, and investment reasoning.
  • Coordinate teams to analyze business models and competitive landscapes.
  • Organize a mock investment committee presentation.
  • Invite relevant speakers where feasible; avoid presenting student work as investment advice.
Director of Entrepreneurship

To be announced

Director position planned. Name, portrait, and biography forthcoming.

  • Coordinate cross-division collaboration on prototypes.
  • Host a demo day and document project lessons.
